title: RpcNIC: Enabling Efficient Datacenter RPC Offloading on PCIe-attached SmartNICs
problem: RPC processing has become a dominant datacenter tax in microservice/serverless environments, but existing RPC accelerators either integrate logic into the CPU or use specialized low-latency interconnects unavailable in commodity servers, preventing broad deployment.
motivation: As networking speeds rise and software stacks grow more complex, RPC serialization/deserialization overhead consumes an ever-larger fraction of CPU cycles, creating a compelling case for PCIe-attached SmartNIC offload if its inherent PCIe bandwidth and latency challenges can be overcome.
method: RpcNIC is a software-hardware co-designed SmartNIC on Xilinx U280 FPGA using three techniques to mitigate PCIe overhead: (1) a target-aware deserializer that batches cross-PCIe writes on SmartNIC SRAM using compacted hardware data structures to reduce PCIe transaction count; (2) a memory-affinity CPU-SmartNIC collaborative serializer that trades host memory copies for slow PCIe transfers, keeping data on the host side for NUMA-affine access; and (3) an automatic field update mechanism that dynamically reconfigures RPC kernel schema encoding to minimize redundant PCIe traversals when application schemas change.
key_novelty: A three-pronged PCIe-aware co-design that makes commodity PCIe-attached SmartNICs competitive with specialized low-latency interconnect RPC accelerators for datacenter workloads.
contributions: Target-aware deserializer with compacted SRAM data structures for batched cross-PCIe writes
Memory-affinity collaborative serializer trading host copies for slow PCIe transfers
Automatic field update technique for reconfigurable RPC kernel schema with minimal PCIe overhead
2.3x lower RPC processing time and 2.6x throughput over comparable RPC accelerator on HyperProtoBench

metrics.speedup: 2.3x lower RPC layer processing time vs. comparable RPC accelerator; 2.6x achievable throughput in end-to-end cloud workload

limitations: Prototype is FPGA-based (Xilinx U280); ASIC implementation area/power characteristics not evaluated.
primary_theme: PCIe-aware SmartNIC hardware-software co-design for datacenter RPC offload
